description: Create a wiki (or, with parentWikiID, a sub wiki) in a project you can access, after the user approved its title and content. If an active wiki with the same name (case and spaces ignored) already exists under the same parent, it is returned unchanged with isExisting: true, so sending the same request again never duplicates wikis. Use it only when the user asks to write something to the wiki.

content.description: Markdown (headings, lists, tables, code, links); line breaks are kept. Raw HTML is shown as text; only http, https, mailto and relative links are kept.

name.description: Wiki title. An active wiki with the same name (case and spaces ignored) under the same parent is returned unchanged instead of creating another one.

parentWikiID.description: Wiki of the same project to create a sub wiki under (see laviya_list_wikis). Default: a top-level wiki of the project.

project.description: Project name, part of it, or task prefix (e.g. LVY) instead of projectID. It must match exactly one of your projects.

projectID.description: Laviya project (see laviya_list_projects). Pass projectID or project.

relatedTaskIDs.description: Tasks of the same project, mentioned at the end of the wiki (at most 50).

requestKey.description: Idempotency key, echoed back. Defaults to a hash of the request.

name: laviya_create_wiki
title: Create Wiki
